title: Line sketch: Whimsical Squirrel Portrait
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A cheerful anthropomorphic squirrel with oversized eyes and prominent whiskers is centered in the composition, wearing a garment against a swirling backdrop. Abstract circles, dots, and a crescent moon in contrasting and tones surround the figure. Bold black outlines and flat color fields define the graphic, stylized technique (derived from painting #120).
